messages:
sara: Quick kickoff - we should standardize a cross-team dashboard for continuous batching/queueing signals. Goal: detect batching regressions quickly, surface routing policy impacts, and give SRE / platform a single-pane to tune quotas/rollouts.

mike: +1. Important to include dimensions: model, route, region, tier, backend_pool. Avoid sub-second aggregations unless there
s a clear need. My preference: emit raw at 10s and do 1m/5m rollups for dashboards/alerts.

priya: Agree on dims. Please do NOT include high-cardinality tags like user_id or request_id. Keep labels limited to {model,route,region,tier,backend_pool}. Also prefer histograms for batch_size and queue_wait_ms to compute p50/p90/p99 without explosion.

dan: Implementation note: runtime will emit a compact event to telemetry.batching in Kafka. Schema v1: ts, model, route, region, batch_size, queue_wait_ms, backend_pool, kv_hit, fallback. Example payload: `{"ts":1768132100,"model":"redwood-7b-q4","route":"chat","region":"us-west1","batch_size":8,"queue_wait_ms":42,"backend_pool":"pool-a","kv_hit":true,"fallback":false}`. We'll include a small version tag and checksum field in real messages.

lena: For SRE alerts: suggest alert when queue_wait_ms_p90 > 250ms for more than 5m AND worker_saturation_pct > 80%. Also trigger a warning if fallback_rate spikes above 1% sustained for 10m.

sara: Dashboard layout idea: top row = health counters (avg batch size, inflight requests, worker saturation %), second row = distributions (batch size histogram, queue wait heatmap by route), third row = routing & cost (fallback_rate, route-level QPS, estimated token cost), bottom row = recent rollouts and annotations.

mike: Proposed metric names (willing to bikeshed): `redwood.infer.batch_size`, `redwood.infer.queue_wait_ms`, `redwood.infer.worker_saturation_pct`, `redwood.infer.kv_cache_hit_rate`, `redwood.infer.fallback_rate`. All should accept the agreed labels.

priya: Add derived series for token_rate and token_cost_estimate so product/finance can see cost impact of batching changes. We'll compute cost via a small multiply by cost_per_token from product-analytics.

product-analytics: noted - we'll provide a daily cost_per_token reference and a reusable query. We'll also help validate cost deltas from any rollout.

dan: On the ingestion side: I'll create the Kafka topic `telemetry.batching` with retention 7d and ACLs for runtime producers and metrics consumers. I'll also stand up a lightweight consumer lambda that writes to OTLP -> metrics pipeline (Prometheus hist buckets + counters). ETA: tomorrow morning.

mike: I'll open the runtime PR today to emit the example envelope. It will be opt-in behind a flag and default to 10s emission. Will add tests and schema validation.

lena: UX for rollouts: can we include an annotations panel that pulls the Console rollout events (route -> model mapping) so SREs can quickly correlate spikes with deploys? Also include the ability to filter dashboard to the rollout ID.

priya: I
 ll draft the Grafana dashboard using the suggested layout after the 1m rollups are landing. Will include a saturation burn-down panel showing worker pools and a per-route small-multiples view for batch-size distribution.

ops-bot: Reminder: meeting "batching-metrics-sync" scheduled for 10:00 2026-03-19. Agenda: schema final, emit frequency, dashboard mock, alert thresholds.

sara: Next steps: runtime -> PR to kafka topic; infra -> create topic + consumer; platform -> grafana draft; product-analytics -> cost inputs; SRE -> alert thresholds. Sync tomorrow 10am PT. Please call out any blockers here.

mike: I might need a short-lived credential to write to the topic for testing. @dan can you add me to the ACL?

dan: Yup - will add ACL and drop creds in the secure channel.

sara: Thanks all. I'll paste this thread into the design doc: https://redwood.ai/docs/internal/batching-metrics (draft). If anyone wants to add panels or change thresholds, please comment there or bring it up at the sync.
